capricorn_6.summary: Total devotion, in a faithful protector or a ruthless pragmatist.
capricorn_6.fullText: Capable of giving itself completely to one passion, one cause or one person. The degree cuts two ways. Placements may be the innocent, loyal guardian, or the cunning operator who will sacrifice others for advantage. They have a particular skill for boiling old wisdom down into practical use, and hold themselves to a strict code. Life here has concealed dangers. Careful judgment and intentions that stay kind are what keep the legacy from being one of cruelty or isolation.

capricorn_7.title: Capricorn 7
capricorn_7.summary: An ingenious, secretive mind that gets caught in its own maze.
capricorn_7.fullText: Complicated and clever, with a real love of art and beauty. Placements tangle themselves in elaborate constructions of their own and in pessimistic fixed ideas. Rivalry and jealousy mark the life, and a good deal of the damage is self-inflicted. The need to control how things turn out, and a righteous grip on old grievances, bring progress to a halt and leave them alone. Grudges dropped and unfinished business completed, the intellect is free for something harmonious.

capricorn_8.title: Capricorn 8
capricorn_8.summary: Solitary psychic depth, estranged from the everyday world.
capricorn_8.fullText: Intuitive, solitary and inclined to sadness. Placements feel out of place in ordinary life. They may have marked psychic ability or occult knowledge, and can pass on truths of a higher order for the guidance of others. Misused, for manipulation or for sensual excess, the same inner life turns into heavy sorrow, grievous loss, or a cynical distance from people. Meditation alone, strict discipline, and service in place of worldly power are where this degree finds its peace.

capricorn_9.title: Capricorn 9
capricorn_9.summary: Inspired endurance on a steep road, with temper and appetite to master.
capricorn_9.fullText: A soul with large things to do and a hard climb to reach them. The trials are severe and tiring. Placements may contend with strong sensual appetites, or with a rough, irritable temper that drives off their supporters and prepares a tragic fall. They are led all the same by an inner light, and have a gift for healing through ritual, and for humility. With the lower instincts mastered and long labour given to a high cause, the end is illumination and an honoured name.

capricorn_10.title: Capricorn 10
capricorn_10.summary: Prudent, wise and protective; a defender who asks for no credit.
capricorn_10.fullText: Careful and far-seeing, with a strong instinct to protect the vulnerable and to look for what is hidden. Night work, occultism and the less familiar sciences attract this degree, and placements feel fed by wild places and the unknown. They are militant in a good cause, and the zeal needs cooling so that it does not lead into needless danger. Quiet observation and a philosophical grasp of life's mysteries secure their success. Glory is not what they want.

capricorn_11.title: Capricorn 11
capricorn_11.summary: Opposites pulled apart so that they can be joined again.
capricorn_11.fullText: Opposing forces meet here, and the strain between them shapes the whole life. Placements are driven to bring the two back together. That means standing between careful discrimination and complete letting-go, and between tradition and what is new, giving each its due. The task is large and belongs to more than one person. It is also the making of them: conviction, sympathy, and acceptance of what cannot be avoided open the way to wholeness.

capricorn_12.title: Capricorn 12
capricorn_12.summary: A retentive, observant mind for study, with cunning to guard against.
capricorn_12.fullText: Memory is exceptional and observation close. Placements are fitted for deep study of nature and of hidden things, and for research or teaching. The caution is specific. Craftiness, secret dealing and predatory behaviour are the temptations of a mind this capable. Used to manipulate people, the gift spoils. Used to find out what is true, it brings substantial and lasting success in whatever field they choose.

capricorn_13.title: Capricorn 13
capricorn_13.summary: A bold, self-made leader whose severity needs tempering.
capricorn_13.fullText: Adventurous and fiery, and thoughtful with it. Placements want new territory, or old wisdom dug up again, and are after truth without qualification. They are highly capable, usually self-made, and do not avoid a risk. Harshness is the fault. They can be exacting, critical and at worst ruthlessly aggressive. The drive to conquer needs honest reflection and compassion beside it, and with those this degree reaches the best it is capable of.

capricorn_14.title: Capricorn 14
capricorn_14.summary: An incisive critic who uncovers facts and is seldom satisfied.
capricorn_14.fullText: Piercing, inquisitive and analytical. This degree takes structures and beliefs apart as a matter of habit. It produces good researchers, statisticians and critics, people who bring important truths to light. The same fault-finding breeds discontent and friction with others. Emotional steadiness has to be worked at, and a negative or combative turn avoided. The intellect is best used to refine and improve what is there. Pulling it down is the easier and lesser use.

capricorn_15.title: Capricorn 15
capricorn_15.summary: Devoted service to others, carried mostly alone.
capricorn_15.fullText: A large capacity for devotion and self-sacrifice, and a real concern for other people's welfare. Placements take on heavy responsibility. They are drawn to nursing and healing, or to the deeper questions of science and human life. The road is often lonely. Recognition is scarce, setbacks come suddenly, and worldly struggle can feel overwhelming. Fulfilment comes from keeping the ideal high and continuing to comfort others whether or not anything comes back.

capricorn_16.title: Capricorn 16
capricorn_16.summary: Youthful, sociable and gentle, and too soft for a hard knock.
capricorn_16.fullText: Youth, physical fitness and social life are the interests. Placements want to stay young and throw themselves into community activity. The nature is easygoing and sympathetic. It is also too tender to meet the world's harder difficulties head on. The risks are self-indulgence and a reliance on passive resistance alone. Gentle ideals are easily corrupted from outside, and this degree has to build some inner toughness in order to keep them.

capricorn_17.title: Capricorn 17
capricorn_17.summary: A many-sided, private character that will not be classified.
capricorn_17.fullText: A puzzling degree that combines traits which seem not to belong together. Placements are deeply secretive and deeply faithful, and guard the private self fiercely. The intellect is shrewd and analytical. They can change dramatically and fit themselves to almost any role. The danger lies in the secrecy. If it slides into unreliability or hidden motives that do harm, the result is serious friction with others and isolation within.

capricorn_18.title: Capricorn 18
capricorn_18.summary: A competitor's courage, in a life of conflict and sharp reversals.
capricorn_18.fullText: Striving, rivalry and repeated collisions with outside hardship. Placements have an aggressive spirit that does not give way, and are attracted to high risk, physical effort and dramatic turns of fortune. They can ride out a very heavy storm and keep their dignity. What threatens the ground under them is avoidable: disputes that need not have been joined, gambling, and destructive anger. Wariness on those three points is the whole advice.

capricorn_19.title: Capricorn 19
capricorn_19.summary: Self-reliant endurance that shoulders the load and will not bend.
capricorn_19.fullText: Great stamina of body and mind. Placements are ready for heavy responsibility and can get value out of the hardest circumstances. They are independent, resourceful and tenacious in their convictions, which makes them formidable in business or politics. Stubbornness is the price. A refusal to adapt leaves them alone. Success of the best kind needs some emotional give alongside the relentless drive for material or social achievement.

capricorn_20.title: Capricorn 20
capricorn_20.summary: A receptive, adaptable nature that steadies the people around it.
capricorn_20.fullText: Intuitive and spiritually inclined, with a talent for bringing harmony into a room. Placements adapt easily and do well in shared, artistic or public work, where connection is the point. Others take encouragement from them. The risks are on the surface: vanity, imitation in place of substance, and a restlessness that moves on too soon. Held in check, the gift produces something lasting.

capricorn_21.title: Capricorn 21
capricorn_21.summary: A studious reformer who joins old knowledge to present need.
capricorn_21.fullText: Studious, intuitive and energetic, drawn to ancient wisdom, to science and to the large questions of human life. Placements work well with others and want to reform things. They make original discoveries and not uncommonly found a new school of thought. The presence is magnetic, sometimes romantic. Over-sensitivity and emotional escape are the pitfalls. Methodical research and a liking for fair competition ground the work, and it can change a society.

capricorn_22.title: Capricorn 22
capricorn_22.summary: Resolute labour that learns equally from winning and losing.
capricorn_22.fullText: Hard-working and exceptionally determined. Placements want to raise others up and to build on a sound base, and they do not avoid heavy or difficult tasks. Endurance of body and mind is great. Ambition is intense and stubbornness goes with it, and both need direction or they harden into ruthlessness. A philosophical view of life's battles helps. Taking defeat and victory with equal grace, they leave a well-earned record of strength and protection.

capricorn_23.title: Capricorn 23
capricorn_23.summary: Genial, passionate and brave, in need of moderation.
capricorn_23.fullText: Intelligent and warm, meeting life with great enthusiasm and plenty of company. Placements are capable of real bravery and of winning the rewards society gives. The danger is excess: extravagance, self-indulgence, and reckless love affairs. Resources are overstretched and feelings get out of hand, and a sudden reversal can cost what was hard to earn. With discipline, the love of comfort sits alongside acts of heroism and considerable philosophical depth.

capricorn_24.title: Capricorn 24
capricorn_24.summary: Sincere, orderly and practical, with faith that sees it through.
capricorn_24.fullText: Steadfast and unassuming, a natural protector and organiser of whatever is near. Placements often feel marked out by destiny and are drawn to aims beyond the ordinary and to serious spiritual commitment. An orderly mind and firm faith bring them clear of approaching danger, sometimes narrowly. They want to face the world's illusions and are good at reducing a complicated problem to its simplest truth. In the laboratory or the cloister, sincerity is what defeats deceit and adversity.

capricorn_25.title: Capricorn 25
capricorn_25.summary: Charm and good fortune, resting on too little substance.
capricorn_25.fullText: Sociable, expansive and fond of comfort, art and luxury. Placements attract luck, wealthy partners and influential positions with apparent ease. They are inclined to harvest what others planted and to prefer a light, passing existence to long hard work. Vanity and shallowness leave them exposed to sudden reversal and to enemies they have not noticed. Imagination needs grounding and real substance needs building, so that pleasure-seeking turns into something creative.

capricorn_26.title: Capricorn 26
capricorn_26.summary: Calm on the surface, strong underneath, and happiest outdoors.
capricorn_26.fullText: Compassionate, independent and fond of nature. The manner is tranquil and conceals great inner strength. Placements want to protect the vulnerable and to see the world, and do best in open country. A rich imagination lets them adapt to almost anything. The risk is escape. Unchecked impulse, or a wish to avoid conflict altogether, ends in drifting. With discipline and a hold on their deep reserves of feeling, they become a steady and persuasive force for humane ends.

capricorn_27.title: Capricorn 27
capricorn_27.summary: A gruff, authentic nature that prefers quiet work to notice.
capricorn_27.fullText: Rugged and inward, with no patience for social pretence. A rough exterior covers a thoughtful, kind and devoted heart. Placements rise slowly and by steady application, toward mastery of a practical or a spiritual kind. They are happiest in peaceful country places and out of the limelight. Too much solitude is the hazard, and with it a sour view of humankind. Patient and unpretentious, they steady others and give sound, healing advice to those who ask.

capricorn_28.title: Capricorn 28
capricorn_28.fullText: A strong, exact and capable intellect. Placements may serve as a dependable guide, work at the frontier of a science, or carry through a very large organisational task. Their concentration is such that petty critics go unnoticed and enormous burdens are brought to completion. Wealth and authority may follow. So does the weight of duty, which they feel keenly. Exhaustion is the danger, and lighter pleasures, simple recreation and some spiritual joy are the remedy.

capricorn_29.title: Capricorn 29
capricorn_29.summary: A contemplative reader of nature's signs, prone to low spirits.
capricorn_29.fullText: Philosophical and deeply intuitive. Placements learn by watching nature quietly and by attending to the meanings underneath things. They are given to melancholy and to living alone. Their ability to read life's subtle marks, and to connect the wisdom of the past with the present, makes them good guides. Competition does not interest them; silent communion with universal law does. Poetic and visionary as they are, fatalistic gloom has to be resisted.

capricorn_30.title: Capricorn 30
capricorn_30.summary: Executive ambition aimed at the top, and liable to fall as fast as it rises.
capricorn_30.fullText: Forceful, ambitious and commanding, intent on the highest levels of power and influence. The mind is very quick and can concentrate hard. Restlessness and impulse give the career the path of a meteor: a sudden ascent, and the risk of an equally sudden drop. Pride and the hostility of powerful rivals are what bring it down. Self-mastery is essential. So is a willingness to discuss and collaborate, which turns raw determination into lasting standing.

aquarius_1.title: Aquarius 1
aquarius_1.summary: A pioneering mind for science or humane work, needing firm ground.
aquarius_1.fullText: Independent and imaginative, with a strong bent for science, invention or leadership in a humanitarian cause. Placements see the wider picture. They want to bring out ideas that are fresh and their own, and that will outlast them. The practical work is the difficulty. A habit of standing aloof, or of living in dreams that cannot be carried out, wastes the promise and lets opportunities go. Vision here has to be tied down to fact.

aquarius_2.title: Aquarius 2
aquarius_2.summary: A capable, organised intellect that rebuilds better after each shock.
aquarius_2.fullText: Observant, orderly and highly able, good at business, scientific research or strategy. Placements are practical and on the whole lucky. Even so, life delivers sudden storms: reversals nobody predicted, and shocks that go deep. Temper and withdrawal are the wrong responses. Inner security is the right one. With it, a crisis strips away what was unnecessary, and they build again on ground that is firmer and better understood.

aquarius_3.title: Aquarius 3
aquarius_3.summary: Resilience that breaks with old loyalties to find its own way.
aquarius_3.fullText: Courageous and intuitive, attracted to the unusual, to the natural world, or to metaphysics. Deep changes go on inside. Placements often feel they must reject confining social rules or former allegiances outright in order to discover who they are. The price can be severe: shocks to body or feeling, and long stretches alone. Faith and perseverance carry them, and the freedom they reach in the end is bright and thoroughly earned.

aquarius_4.title: Aquarius 4
aquarius_4.summary: A sensitive idealist with a gift for healing, mental or physical.
aquarius_4.fullText: Refined, poetic and kind. Placements have an unusual ability to bring spiritual energy to bear on practical relief, and to ease other people's suffering. They are sociable, eccentric, and inclined to wander, and their warmth gathers friends and admirers with no effort. The calling is to bring peace and light to people in distress. Frivolity, vanity and the distraction of their own sensual wishes are what stand between them and it.

aquarius_5.title: Aquarius 5
aquarius_5.summary: Independent leadership that stands on inherited ground.
aquarius_5.fullText: Ardent, idealistic and unafraid of a challenge. Placements think clearly and draw real strength from tradition or family roots, which is why they step forward when things go wrong. They can carry large aims through to the end. What undoes them is their own certainty: stubbornness, overconfidence and a taste for long odds. A miscalculation here tends to be a public one, so moderation is what secures the honours.

aquarius_6.title: Aquarius 6
aquarius_6.summary: A sharp, inventive progressive, drawn to a public or ceremonial part.
aquarius_6.fullText: Critical, quick and original. Placements are committed progressives who enjoy experimental ideas and truths that apply everywhere. They like to stand where a group's energy gathers, and express their ideals through drama, ceremony or public office. The gift for communication is fierce. Used to win arguments, it produces endless disputes and drives supporters away. Used in real service to others, with some compassion, it does what they hoped it would.

aquarius_7.title: Aquarius 7
aquarius_7.summary: Tact and insight that announce a wider way of seeing.
aquarius_7.fullText: Courteous, intricate and deeply intuitive. What placements do tends to signal a new and broader outlook arriving. The temperament is calm. They read people remarkably well and keep spiritual insight and practical affairs in balance. The temptation is to pull back into a sheltered, defenceless privacy. Resisting it, they use a generous breadth of mind to bring about real social change and to give their community an entirely new framework.

aquarius_8.title: Aquarius 8
aquarius_8.summary: Forceful determination that escapes its own confinement and sets an example.
aquarius_8.fullText: Intense and resolute, and somewhat dogmatic. Placements feel shut in by circumstance, by surroundings, or by habits of their own that have set hard. They have a soldier's energy and a great thirst for release, and the courage to break out of a prison whether it is physical or mental. Afterwards, their conduct and their hard-won wisdom become a pattern for others. Respect follows, and so does a plain demonstration of what people can come through.

aquarius_9.title: Aquarius 9
aquarius_9.summary: An idealist who can make a principle into a living force.
aquarius_9.fullText: Alert, optimistic and fearless, forever looking for final truths and principles that hold everywhere. The rare ability here is embodiment. Placements can take a great idea and personify it so completely that a symbol becomes an active power for change. They succeed in business and in social reform. Pace is the hazard. Impulsive, fast-moving energy causes accidents, to the body or the feelings, unless mature judgment is in charge.

aquarius_10.title: Aquarius 10
aquarius_10.summary: A serious figure made into a public symbol, who must stay himself.
aquarius_10.fullText: Observant, practical and responsible, taking a wide view and approaching problems from unexpected angles. Placements catch the public imagination easily. They find themselves pushed forward as the face of a popular ideal or movement. The lesson of the degree is that this kind of fame is temporary and not really about them. Their task is to keep their own integrity intact while the crowd attaches its hopes to them and then moves on.

aquarius_11.title: Aquarius 11
aquarius_11.summary: Sudden inspiration and inventive power, needing moral discipline.
aquarius_11.fullText: A lively, inventive mind open to flashes of inspiration strong enough to change the direction of a life. Placements join progressive or humanitarian movements and want to make work that lasts and improves society. The dangers are headlong force and rushing at risks they have not looked at. Easy, short-lived popularity tempts them, and so do darker, self-defeating impulses that only scatter what they have. Ideals held in place by firm morals bring brilliant, durable success.

aquarius_12.title: Aquarius 12
aquarius_12.summary: A reformer and teacher who must not turn bitter when disappointed.
aquarius_12.fullText: Sensitive and idealistic, with an understanding of how human beings develop that goes unusually deep. Placements are natural healers or instructors. They help others upward and keep their own spiritual values while doing it. Imagination is poetic, sympathy wide, and public service a common choice. Seeing the world's inequalities so clearly, they risk heavy disillusionment. Cynical secrecy, cold withdrawal and crippling doubt are the responses to refuse.

aquarius_13.title: Aquarius 13
aquarius_13.summary: An objective reader of signs, who should keep one foot at home.
aquarius_13.fullText: Perceptive, curious and detached. Placements read the small indications in nature and in society, see a trend before it arrives, and get at basic natural facts. That lets them plan with great accuracy. They often feel pushed toward the unknown and may cut every tie with the past in order to go their own way. Occult or scientific discernment is the gain. Ordinary domestic harmony is the counterweight, and without it they come dangerously adrift.

aquarius_14.title: Aquarius 14
aquarius_14.summary: A restless, many-sided mind with too much in hand at once.
aquarius_14.fullText: Active and versatile, usually running several projects or philosophies together. Placements are drawn to psychological depths and feel obliged to look into the most concealed parts of human nature, clearing up what people in general prefer not to see. Resourcefulness gets them round the usual obstacles and into new connections. Dispersed energy brings anxiety, nervous exhaustion or accidents. A single steady aim, and a settled home to lean on, make the ambition safe.

aquarius_15.title: Aquarius 15
aquarius_15.summary: Cosmopolitan confidence and good fortune, at risk of setting hard.
aquarius_15.fullText: Adventurous and communicative, steered by a faith that does not shake. Placements have a flair for leadership and a real appreciation of what is beautiful in life. Friends, money and public recognition come readily. They travel, read and explore, and spread optimism as they go. The fault is unexpected: too much consistency. They can become fixed in repeated habits or in a public character they built with care. Staying emotionally flexible keeps the momentum.

aquarius_16.title: Aquarius 16
aquarius_16.summary: A commanding organiser of large affairs, who must not lose the human side.
aquarius_16.fullText: Robust and methodical. Placements manage big undertakings, complicated systems and intricate technical arrangements, and do it well. They are fired by a wish to be of practical use and have the exactness that solid worldly achievement requires. In business, law or science the approach is rational and asks for proof. The warning is that results can crowd out compassion. When that happens, life answers with disorder they cannot manage, or a barrenness of feeling.

aquarius_17.title: Aquarius 17
aquarius_17.summary: Vigilant independence that guards its own, and risks ending up alone.
aquarius_17.fullText: Protective, self-governing and a little eccentric. Placements watch over their autonomy and their resources without letting up. They feel close to ancient wisdom, analyse sharply, and have the quiet toughness to stand against general opinion. Investigative or highly specialised work suits them. Distrust of people, extreme obstinacy and outright suspicion threaten to cut them off entirely. Warmth, an open mind and a readiness to share what they see are the correctives.

aquarius_18.title: Aquarius 18
aquarius_18.summary: A hard start, a guarded manner, and a reckoning that clears the air.
aquarius_18.fullText: Analytical, complicated and fiercely independent, shaped by early difficulty. Placements tend to keep their motives private, work by unusual methods, and cover vulnerability with composure. At some point the cover comes off, in public or in private, and that moment is the turning point. With suspicion set down and damaging attachments avoided, the strategic mind that got them through hardship takes them somewhere considerably brighter.

aquarius_19.title: Aquarius 19
aquarius_19.summary: Calm calculation that puts out fires and succeeds late.
aquarius_19.fullText: Observant, composed and very hard to defeat. This degree lives through great changes of fortune and through public upheaval. Placements repeatedly face blazes of feeling or circumstance, and have the detachment and inner reserve to put them out and restore order. They act on careful reckoning and psychological insight, never on a rash impulse, and express themselves gracefully. Their best and most lasting success, and their recognition, come in the second half of life.

aquarius_20.title: Aquarius 20
aquarius_20.summary: A patient, gifted go-between, working through quiet intention.
aquarius_20.fullText: Enduring and charismatic, with deep intuition and refined talent in music, art or science. Placements often carry something of a spiritual message to the people around them. They meet the hardest challenges with a faith that is close to mystical. Their power is quiet and connective, and what they intend inwardly matters far more than any outward show. Dictatorial pride is the one thing to resist. Otherwise success, long life and wide respect come naturally.

aquarius_21.title: Aquarius 21
aquarius_21.summary: Disappointment met with self-command, and turned to others' good.
aquarius_21.fullText: A degree that has to face disillusion: hopes that failed, or circumstances that feel empty. Where passion goes unchecked, placements meet abrupt reversals or are pulled into violent, destructive outbursts. The other course takes courage. Trials are accepted, with no giving in to despair and no revenge. Strength grows from that, and past injuries become a renewed ability to guide and protect other people. The fulfilment is real and owes nothing to appearances.

aquarius_22.title: Aquarius 22
aquarius_22.summary: Diligent craft and cooperation, with what is built kept safe.
aquarius_22.fullText: Hard-working and conscientious. Placements do best in methodical work, mutual help and shared effort, and take real satisfaction in it. The limelight does not attract them. They would sooner lay a secure foundation by quiet craftsmanship and give warmth, shelter and understanding to those nearby. One caution applies. What they have built, and the comforts they have earned, need protecting against sudden hazards and natural disaster. Success arrives steadily and by humble means.

aquarius_23.title: Aquarius 23
aquarius_23.summary: Self-discipline and gentle resilience in an artistic or spiritual nature.
aquarius_23.fullText: Intuitive, with gifts for art, letters or spiritual things. Self-discipline is the strength. Placements acquire unusual skills by unconventional training, by learning alone, or through hard experience. They may be frail in body or feeling, and lack aggressive drive, and they bend when adversity blows hard. They do not break. Literary, artistic or botanical talent, cultivated, lets them pass on real wisdom and turn hardship into something beautiful that lasts.

aquarius_24.title: Aquarius 24
aquarius_24.summary: Turbulent passion that becomes wisdom once it is mastered.
aquarius_24.fullText: The central matter is an inner fight to tame desires that are deep and stormy. Left alone, they lead to vindictiveness, to violent scenes, or to severe censure from society. Placements learn most from their worst experiences, including the ones they brought on themselves. With the primitive instincts conquered, dark feeling is changed into understanding. In the end they teach and guide people who are travelling the same troubled road.

aquarius_25.title: Aquarius 25
aquarius_25.summary: A brilliant reasoner who can walk straight into a hole.
aquarius_25.fullText: Logical and highly perceptive, and in some respects ahead of ordinary development. Placements live by strict discipline and restraint. They lean so heavily on reason that instinct and plain practical fact are ignored, and the imbalance is dangerous. Intellectual arrogance, or a want of grounded experience, sends them toward disaster without seeing it. Wiser companions are worth listening to. Everyday common sense has to keep pace with the mental brilliance.

aquarius_26.title: Aquarius 26
aquarius_26.summary: Practical, sociable efficiency, with a clear eye for how things work.
aquarius_26.fullText: Good at analysing and managing whatever is going on around it. Placements may apply technical skill to everyday problems, or run a comfortable and welcoming household, and in both cases enjoy serving and connecting with their community. The intellect is sharp and observant. It collects facts readily and understands mechanisms. One caution: a fascination with the shallow or decaying side of society. A wholesome, productive and independent life is the better aim.

aquarius_27.title: Aquarius 27
aquarius_27.summary: Delicate feeling and old values, choosing between honest work and escape.
aquarius_27.fullText: Refined and sensitive, able to make things of lasting beauty and to keep faith with tradition. The choice before this degree is stark. On one side stands disciplined, patient effort. On the other stand gambling, addiction and lazy escape, to all of which placements are unusually exposed. Self-control and plain, honest industry decide it. By laying the ground for the future steadily and refusing dissipated habits, they build a life with meaning and artistic reward.

aquarius_28.title: Aquarius 28
aquarius_28.summary: Provident skill that cuts a way through and lays in for hard times.
aquarius_28.fullText: Remarkable ability to carry things out, to attack a problem and to defend a position. Placements look ahead intelligently and secure what will be needed before the difficult season arrives. The mind is sharp and penetrating. They take real pleasure in practical preparation and in doing a task exactly. The road involves hard labour and strict self-discipline. Continuous, well-planned effort earns honourable success, and with it security and distinction.

aquarius_29.title: Aquarius 29
aquarius_29.summary: Commanding ambition that must be remade from within.
aquarius_29.fullText: Natural authority, strict integrity and a wish to accomplish something large. Placements often rise to positions of executive power. Their real success lies elsewhere, in breaking out of old confining patterns and passing through a complete change of the inner self. It is a critical passage. Those who come through it are more developed and clearer in mind, able to hold substantial influence and remain entirely calm within.

aquarius_30.title: Aquarius 30
aquarius_30.summary: Serene intuition that joins old wisdom to what is coming.
aquarius_30.fullText: Calm and whole in outlook, with a strong feeling of connection to everything else and of human brotherhood. Placements get beyond ordinary limits and find beauty and new life among the remains of the past. Judgment is sober and logical, and joined to a natural leaning toward occult or spiritual arts. They trust quiet inner realisations and stay open to the highest influences. The result is a harmonious self-mastery, and a part in beginning new cycles.

pisces_1.title: Pisces 1
pisces_1.summary: Generous, adaptable and at ease in a crowd, where it brings unlike things together.
pisces_1.fullText: Compassionate and open-handed, with literary or artistic tastes and a broad feeling for humanity. Placements do well in busy, public settings, and in trade and exchange. They reconcile elements that would otherwise pull apart. Blending in comes naturally, and they sense the mood of a group at once. The same gift makes them easy to sway, and they can lose themselves among other people. Integrity kept, they gain lasting success and a peaceful home.

pisces_2.title: Pisces 2
pisces_2.summary: Intuitive and sympathetic, undermined by idleness and by reliance on luck.
pisces_2.fullText: Instinctive and highly sensitive, with a pull toward spiritual or philosophical matters. Placements are sociable and persuasive, widely imaginative, and tender toward anyone who suffers. Three habits work against them: laziness, extreme restlessness, and a way of putting on one disguise after another to avoid facing hard facts. Speculation is a hazard too. Practical firmness, and less dependence on chance or on other people's work, prevent the sudden setback and the self-made struggle.

pisces_3.title: Pisces 3
pisces_3.summary: An original, psychic mind standing between two worlds.
pisces_3.fullText: Unusually perceptive, hospitable and magnetic. Placements often act as a link between material life and the spiritual. They can draw on what people in general are thinking and feeling, and use an inventive mind to find a way through situations that are complicated or concealed. A deep inner life and a grasp of human nature bring them money and influential friends. The urge to retreat inward is strong. Scattering, secrecy and loss of touch with practical reality are the risks.

pisces_4.title: Pisces 4
pisces_4.summary: Steady and self-reliant in confusion, a light others steer by.
pisces_4.fullText: Intense, creative and something of a medium, and at the same time self-sufficient and good at getting things done. Placements frequently find themselves in the middle of disorder, under pressure from outside, or in narrow and confining circumstances. They hold firm and others take direction from them. They are highly impressionable and seem to draw strength from life itself. Fear and melancholy can paralyse. Looking upward, and trusting their own inner strength, keeps them in command.

pisces_5.title: Pisces 5
pisces_5.summary: Warm, sociable and fond of comfort, with ideals to keep in step with spending.
pisces_5.fullText: Generous and expansive, drawn to beauty, comfort and pleasure. Under that lies a real spiritual or pioneering impulse, and placements often succeed by gathering people around a shared aim or a charity. The risks follow from their tastes. Love of luxury, romantic adventure and speculative ventures stretch them too far and can turn their fortunes suddenly. Imagination tied to practical dedication achieves a good deal, for themselves and for others.

pisces_6.title: Pisces 6
pisces_6.summary: Formidable focus that rebuilds after a collapse and leads others out.
pisces_6.fullText: Steadfast, observant and resourceful. Placements meet serious difficulty more than once, and may have to reconstruct their lives after an abrupt fall. They are well equipped for it: strong concentration, diplomatic skill, and a determination that is close to military. They overcome adversity and lead. The manner can seem proud, remote or stern. What moves them is devotion to duty and a settled confidence that they will come through.

pisces_7.title: Pisces 7
pisces_7.summary: A reflective, divided nature that reaches clarity through concentration.
pisces_7.fullText: Exceptional ability in art, mysticism or scholarship. The temperament is complex and changeable, warmly sociable at one time and cool and distant at another. Placements live with sharp oppositions and feel life as a contest between materialism and a higher idealism. The way through is a single constructive purpose. Their great power of concentration, given to that and lit by a steady inner conviction, lifts them above the conflict and leaves work that inspires.

pisces_8.title: Pisces 8
pisces_8.summary: A strong voice that rouses the community, and must know its limits.
pisces_8.fullText: Intuitive, outspoken and committed, with a deep sense of responsibility and a wish to bring people together. Placements are sympathetic and feel close to the earth and to the common human struggle. They can succeed in practical terms and have real influence where they live. Trouble comes when they overrate their capacity and try to force a result that is beyond them. Humility, and a true estimate of their calling, make them a powerful awakening influence.

pisces_9.title: Pisces 9
pisces_9.summary: Sensitive, romantic and fiercely driven to outrun every rival.
pisces_9.fullText: An uncommon mixture of acute sensitivity, romance and restless force. Placements take adventurous or unconventional roads. They grasp difficult ideas very quickly, and their ambition to leave competitors behind, and to master the darker part of themselves, is strong to the point of fierceness. So much energy gathered together achieves a lot. It also exposes them to emotional extremes, to exhaustion, and to aimless wandering. Discipline keeps the talent fixed to something real.

pisces_10.title: Pisces 10
pisces_10.summary: A brilliant, volatile independent, at home in the upper reaches of thought.
pisces_10.fullText: Highly capable and impossible to confine. Placements refuse ordinary social limits and seem able to rise above natural ones, taking in large currents of thought and moving easily in advanced philosophy, science or the occult. Their outlook is broad and their sympathy for mankind real. Radical restlessness, or a detached sadness, can leave them alone with it. Fulfilment comes from bringing their insights down into organised teaching or leadership that benefits others.

pisces_11.title: Pisces 11
pisces_11.summary: Love of liberty joined to an intuitive search for truth.
pisces_11.fullText: Independent, and intent on finding out what is true by its own lights. Placements may seem restless, or cramped by ordinary limits. They are faithful and protective, and still need freedom to make their own way toward understanding. Anxiety works against them. So does refusing every limitation, since ambitions that accept none are apt to be cut short early. A steady aim and their natural alertness see the search through.

pisces_12.title: Pisces 12
pisces_12.summary: Creative brilliance put through hard tests of character.
pisces_12.fullText: Sensitive, inventive and possibly brilliant. The life includes severe trials of character and commitment. Placements struggle with self-doubt and with sudden breaks in their fortunes, and are tempted to escape into romance or art. Success has conditions. They must accept personal responsibility, choose one road, and overcome the cowardly wish to run from a real challenge. Those who stand fast reach the spiritual or intellectual standing they wanted.

pisces_13.title: Pisces 13
pisces_13.summary: Honest perseverance that lays down its arms and finds security.
pisces_13.fullText: Hard-working, truthful and harmonious by nature. Security comes through persistence and through drawing on what earlier experience taught. Early life may have involved fierce battles, private or public. Peace and stability arrive when placements retire their aggressive defences and take up an ordered, cooperative way of living. Others rely on them as a steady link. Their footing is practical service, natural good sense and a united home.

pisces_14.title: Pisces 14
pisces_14.summary: A sharp, ambitious mind with a sense of mission, safest when honest.
pisces_14.fullText: Active and quick, and convinced of having a particular task or destiny. Placements are direct, and have the protective cunning that dangerous, competitive surroundings call for. The faults are a headstrong, aggressive approach and too much reliance on deception. Either one raises concealed enemies and secret dangers. Honest, dedicated work brings success. Subtlety of mind is properly used here as a shield, and badly used as a weapon.

pisces_15.title: Pisces 15
pisces_15.summary: Vigilant devotion that guards its own with great caution.
pisces_15.fullText: Devoted, watchful and highly protective, taking every care to make its territory secure. Placements can carry heavy responsibility and teach or defend others. Foresight is sharp, and there is a soldier's readiness about them. Two tendencies need moderating: nervousness, and a forceful, domineering manner. Unchecked, they wear placements out or drive away the people being protected. Patient, lasting industry is how they secure the future of family or community.

pisces_16.title: Pisces 16
pisces_16.summary: Inspired and solitary, needing company and firm ground.
pisces_16.fullText: Creative and sensitive, receiving inspiration of a high order, and sometimes isolated because of it. The spirit is daring and independent. Cut off too far from other people, placements risk a sudden and complete collapse, or estrangement from society. Visionary ideals need fastening to practical fact, and supportive friendships need cultivating. Otherwise the end can be a tragic fall, a hermit's bitterness, or a pessimism that destroys. In balance, a powerful inner life brings wide reputation.

pisces_17.title: Pisces 17
pisces_17.summary: Bold energy for large aims and renewal, short on forethought.
pisces_17.fullText: Magnetic, vigorous and ambitious for achievement on a large scale and for a fresh start that is shared publicly. Placements inspire others and take up new beginnings with joy. They are also impulsive, headstrong and reckless, and this brings heavy setbacks and sudden dangers. An ambitious leap can end in a very hard landing. Forethought, control of a combative temper, and a secure, balanced base are the three things that prevent it.

pisces_18.title: Pisces 18
pisces_18.summary: Incisive persuasion that is drawn too readily into a fight.
pisces_18.fullText: Intense and sharp-minded, with a talent for influencing people dramatically. The disposition is assertive and combative. It keeps running the risk of destructive quarrels, of lawsuits, and of traps laid by dishonest people. Placements can fall victim to their own aggression or to the schemes of secret enemies. The fierce energy is better spent raising others up than contending for worldly advantage. Faith maintained, they get the better of serious adversity.

pisces_19.title: Pisces 19
pisces_19.summary: A receptive, philosophical mind hungry for truth, and inclined to scatter.
pisces_19.fullText: Thoughtful and spiritually eager. Placements look for deep knowledge and want to hand on truths that do not change. The calling is high and the difficulties are ordinary: serious indecision, energy spread too thin, and an imagination so busy that it tires out body and feelings. Wandering and restlessness have to give way. Firm faith, concentrated study and commitment to one purposeful road bring both success and healing.

pisces_20.title: Pisces 20
pisces_20.summary: Artistic, responsive and hospitable, needing routine as an anchor.
pisces_20.fullText: Highly sensitive and quick to respond to feeling. Placements are attuned to giving others comfort, food and entertainment. The mind is fast and intuitive, and plenty and social harmony tend to come their way. Stability is the weak point. They are prone to drifting, to unpredictable moods, and to dark, fatalistic imaginings. Practical routines hold the creative and hospitable gifts steady, and with them comes fulfilment that lasts.

pisces_21.title: Pisces 21
pisces_21.summary: An intuitive mystic with conservative footings.
pisces_21.fullText: The temperament is artistic and emotionally sensitive, and intuition runs toward the mystical. What distinguishes this degree is the caution that goes with it. On the things life is founded on, placements are conservative and careful, so that deep feeling and a prudent approach are found in the same person.

pisces_22.title: Pisces 22
pisces_22.fullText: Creative and expressive, with a quick wit and lively enthusiasm. Placements take life spontaneously and enjoy it. The work of the degree is balance. That easy, pleasure-loving approach has to be matched with self-restraint that gives it structure, and with relationships valued for what they really are.

pisces_23.title: Pisces 23
pisces_23.summary: Psychic sight tested in the wilderness.
pisces_23.fullText: Strong psychic perception wakes here, and it has to be kept clear of material greed. The tradition compares the degree to the forty days in the wilderness. The test is a severe one. Placements must see through the illusions the world offers before they can lay claim to a reality that lies beyond them.

pisces_24.title: Pisces 24
pisces_24.summary: Instinct and sexuality, from strict restraint to open passion.
pisces_24.fullText: The sexual and instinctual side of the nature is brought into sharp focus. It can show at either extreme: a puritanical holding-back, or deep and passionate expression. Neither settles the matter. What the degree asks is that this side be consciously understood and given its proper place in the whole person.

pisces_25.title: Pisces 25
pisces_25.summary: A quiet, impressionable nature that needs peaceful surroundings.
pisces_25.fullText: Receptive and quiet. Placements take a strong impression from whatever is around them and are easily influenced by it. Their emotional balance is delicate. A peaceful, supportive environment protects it, and the choice of where and among whom they live matters more here than for most.

pisces_26.title: Pisces 26
pisces_26.summary: Devotion and self-sacrifice in search of unity.
pisces_26.fullText: The personality is moved toward spiritual devotion and toward giving itself up for something greater. Placements are idealists. What they are looking for is complete unity with truths that hold everywhere, and they look for it beyond the limits the physical world sets.

pisces_27.title: Pisces 27
pisces_27.summary: An easygoing, childlike openness to things unseen.
pisces_27.fullText: Uninhibited and childlike in disposition. Placements are open to subtle influences other people do not notice, and may have had unseen playmates when young. They are amiable and easy to be with. What they will not do is conform for the sake of it, and artificial social rules get little from them.

pisces_28.title: Pisces 28
pisces_28.summary: A sharp, healing intellect that finds what others missed.
pisces_28.fullText: A keen and competent mind, suited to discovering nature's secrets in chemistry, anatomy and medicine. Placements have an intuitive gift for diagnosis. It lets them reach the right answer where accepted opinion has failed, and some of their discoveries save lives.

pisces_29.title: Pisces 29
pisces_29.summary: Exacting standards, and the last details put in order.
pisces_29.fullText: This degree demands rigour. Standards are exact and everything is thought through thoroughly before it is passed. The tradition gives it a tidying purpose: what remains unsettled from the past is cleared up here, detail by detail, before a new cycle of life begins.

pisces_30.title: Pisces 30
pisces_30.summary: The last degree: completion, and the ground cleared for Aries.
pisces_30.fullText: The zodiac closes here. The degree stands for the falling away of the separate ego, for union with the whole, and for everything gathered into a final synthesis. It is an ending that prepares a beginning, since the first spark of Aries comes directly after it.

aries_3.title: Aries 3
aries_3.summary: Impulse that swings between reckless courage and a longing for quiet.
aries_3.fullText: A degree of extremes. Placements act on impulse and swing like a pendulum, from rash, headlong courage to a wish for peace, quiet and harmony that seems out of character. Vanity is a mild risk, and so is doing too much. Relationships need real give-and-take before the promise here shows itself. Because everything tends to be all or nothing, firm self-direction is essential, both to keep hold of their own lives and to avoid being used by others.

aries_4.title: Aries 4
aries_4.summary: Abundant, untamed energy that turns everything it touches to account.
aries_4.fullText: A strong, wild force of growth, sometimes called the Midas touch. Placements are like a child in charge of great power: whatever they take up produces results, and fast. The luck is plentiful and can be thrown away just as quickly. Discipline and structure are what keep it from being wasted.

aries_6.title: Aries 6
aries_6.summary: Quick rise to authority, secure only if character keeps pace.
aries_6.fullText: Positions of executive leadership come early and easily to this degree. The warning concerns what the position rests on. Where short-sighted ambition takes the place of spiritual development and of real personal ties, the high standing is pretence, and it is liable to collapse suddenly.

aries_15.title: Aries 15
aries_15.summary: A solitary pioneer working by tested rules.
aries_15.fullText: This degree asks for two things at once: keeping to guidelines that have been proved, and growing a protective shell around the self. Placements resemble a hermit opening up new country. They work quietly and alone, and what they produce is original and of use to society.

aries_24.title: Aries 24
aries_24.summary: Intense creative impulse, clear when it is aimed at the truth.
aries_24.fullText: Creative energy is the keynote, and it is strong. Directed toward what is really true, it brings inspiration of a high order. Directed elsewhere, it brings a Neptunian sort of confusion, and placements then need to look underneath surface appearances and the images people project in order to find their way.

aries_25.title: Aries 25
aries_25.summary: Inborn goodness, with serious study in later life.
aries_25.fullText: Good-natured from birth and full of vitality. Placements have little wish for material wealth. In later life they turn to serious philosophical study and gain a great deal from applying themselves to it. The tradition adds a particular note: they are helped by the loyal support of women friends.
